Key Features & Advantages

Smooth Roller Cam

Enables smooth feeding of the clamp onto steel plates without binding.

Reinforced Jaw Housing

Resists bending moments under heavy lifting chain sling angles.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13155 Standard

Plate clamp compliance.

CE Certified

150% proof load certified.

Product Overview

Used in pairs or sets of four with a two-leg or four-leg chain sling, Europull horizontal clamps allow safe transfer of large steel sheets from cutting beds and warehouse stacks.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp are available?

The Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp is available in 4 models: EP-HPC15, EP-HPC30, EP-HPC50, EP-HPC100. Capacity (Pair) ranges from 1.5 Ton (Pair) to 10.0 Ton (Pair). Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp cover?

The Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp covers 1.5t - 10t.

Which standard does the Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp comply with?

The Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp is manufactured to EN 13155.

What jaw Opening does the Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp have?

The Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp's jaw Opening: 0 to 100 mm.

What configuration does the Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp have?

The Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp's configuration: Must be used in Pairs with a 2-Leg Sling.

What safety Factor does the Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp have?

The Europull Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp's safety Factor: 4:1 Working Load Margin.
